evaluation_components.notes: Students have to participate in these mini case discussions. Anyone absent from class will get no credit in that case. Cases will be assigned time to time

Students will work in groups on any Prescriptive Analytics Problem. Formulate and solve it in Lingo/suitable software, present the findings in a presentation, and submit a report at semester's end. Students can use databases available in the Library to solve a problem in the Marketing, Finance, Operations, Logistics, Supply Chain, or Health Care domains, or in any domain of their interest.

makeup_policy: Make-ups may be allowed only in genuine medical cases with prior permission of I/C. For Quiz and Mini Case discussions, no make-up will be given.
